Working with **seedance-25-director**. I ran the short film-crew single-shot pass first, as the project rules require. (Housekeeping: this workspace isn't a git repo and has no NOTES.md, so there was nothing to pull or read at session start.)

## Why it failed

**Face morphing into another person**
1. **The turn goes past what your one photo shows.** If the photo is frontal and she starts in profile or ¾-back, Seedance has to invent the angles the photo doesn't cover, so it gives you a new face for them. A big turn from profile to full front is the riskiest move you can ask for.
2. **The photo was never tied to her.** Nothing in the prompt says "this photo is her face." "A beautiful woman" is generic, and the model fills it with its own idea of beautiful, which pulls away from your actress.
3. **Walking, turning and smiling happen at once**, in a busy crowd. Passers' faces near hers can blend into hers.
4. **No skin-texture wording.** Without it, faces drift toward the smooth "AI face", which is also less like your actress.

**Sign text turning to gibberish**
- No current video model writes Armenian letters reliably, and letters get worse as the camera moves. "Neon signs in Armenian" asks for exactly what fails. The fix: in the clip, keep signs as soft, unreadable neon glow. Add one real, correctly spelled Armenian sign afterwards in your editor, tracked into the shot.

**Words that do nothing:** "beautiful, cinematic, 4K, IMAX, masterpiece". Seedance doesn't read quality from these words. Resolution is set in the Dreamina settings, not in the prompt, so I removed them all.

## Shot plan (film-crew, one shot)
- **Director:** a woman alone in the evening crowd. Her private walk becomes a direct look and a small smile at us.
- **Set and costume:** a Yerevan street at night with pink and ochre tufa stone buildings, shop windows and neon. Red wool coat. Her face and hair come from your photo.
- **Camera and light:** 50mm, medium close-up. Warm light from the shop windows on frame-left, plus soft neon fill. Shallow focus, so the background and signs melt into colored blur.
- **Camera move:** a slow move backward in front of her the whole time. She starts already turned ¾ toward the lens, so the head turn is only about 30°.
- **Sound:** street sounds and her footsteps, no music.

**Assumptions:** 8 s, 16:9, 720p, Omni Reference mode, and one photo of the actress (front or ¾ view).

## Why each change helps
- The photo is now declared as her only face source, so it can't be confused with crowd faces.
- She starts ¾ toward the lens, so the model never has to invent a side view the photo doesn't show.
- Each time step has one action: walk, then turn, then smile.
- Nobody walks between her and the camera, and no hair crosses her face. Both are common triggers for a face swap.
- The background is blurred and letters are explicitly banned. Real Armenian text goes in during editing.

## Real risks
- If your photo is a full profile, or heavily retouched, the face can still drift. Use a clear front or ¾ photo with natural skin, or use Version B below.
- If it still morphs after 3 tries, change the shot instead of re-rolling. Make a first-frame still of her already facing the lens (banana-pro-director-2.0), then animate it in First and Last Frames mode with only the smile and the camera move.
- The real Armenian sign has to be added afterwards in the edit. No prompt makes Seedance write the letters correctly.

## FINAL

**Version A: one reference photo**

```text
@Image 1: the actress — strict identity reference for the woman. Use only her face, facial structure, skin, hair and hairline from @Image 1; do not take its background, lighting or clothing.

A woman in a red wool coat walks toward the camera along a crowded Yerevan street at night, slowly turns her face to the lens and gives a small, private smile; realistic night street footage, 50mm, shallow depth of field, one continuous take with a slow backward dolly.

Character: the woman is exactly the person in @Image 1 — same face shape, eyes, brows, nose, lips and jawline in every frame, at every angle; warm natural skin tone, retaining real fine pores and skin texture, native skin texture, hair roots distinct; hair exactly as in @Image 1, kept behind her shoulders and off her face. She wears a knee-length tailored red wool coat, matte brushed fabric, buttoned, collar slightly raised.

[0-3s] Medium close-up, chest up. She walks at an unhurried pace toward the camera, her face already turned three-quarters toward the lens, eyes looking past the camera down the street. The camera dollies backward at her walking speed, keeping her centered. Passers-by in soft focus behind her move left and right. Sound: footsteps on stone pavement, distant traffic, murmur of the crowd.
[3-6s] Still walking, she slowly turns only her head toward the lens, about thirty degrees, until her face is fully frontal and her eyes meet the lens, then her head stops. Same framing, same dolly speed. No one passes between her and the camera.
[6-8s] Holding eye contact with the lens, a small closed-lip smile forms: the corners of her mouth lift, her cheeks rise slightly, her eyes narrow a little. She keeps walking slowly; the camera keeps dollying backward. Sound: footsteps, crowd murmur, a faint electric hum of neon.

Global: one continuous shot, no cuts. Location: a Yerevan street at night, pink and ochre tufa stone facades, lit shop windows, neon signs as soft out-of-focus color glow (red, amber, teal), wet-looking dark pavement. Light: warm key light from shop windows on frame-left, soft neon fill on frame-right, the same direction throughout. Her face, hair and red coat stay identical from the first frame to the last. Background signs are blurred light shapes only, with no legible letters. Passers-by stay in the soft background, never look at the camera, and never cover her face. No hair across her face, no face change during the head turn, no extra people in the foreground, no readable text, no subtitles, no background music, pure video.
```

**Settings (Dreamina)**
- Mode: **Omni Reference**
- Model: **Seedance 2.5**
- Duration: **8 s**
- Aspect ratio: **16:9** (choose 9:16 if this is for Reels; the prompt stays the same)
- Resolution: **720p** for test runs. Once the face holds, run the final at the highest resolution your Dreamina plan offers.
- Uploads, in this order:
  - **Version A:** @Image 1 is the actress photo (sharp, front or ¾ view, natural skin, no sunglasses, no hair over the face).
  - **Version B:** @Image 1 front view, @Image 2 ¾ view from her left, @Image 3 ¾ view from her right.
- Before regenerating, delete "4K, IMAX, masterpiece, cinematic, beautiful" from your old prompt. These words are not used here.
- Readable Armenian sign: add it in your editor after generation (track a real sign graphic onto a blurred sign area), not in the prompt.
- Judge each result on the face at 3-6 s, during the head turn. If it drifts 3 times, switch to the first-frame route described in "Real risks" above.
